html:
Unique Research · Company / funding · April 13, 2023

On Apr 7, 2023, AI voice-interaction + AI-data pioneer Beibei Tech (标贝科技) raised ¥100M B2 from Jufeng KeChuang and Qingdao Wealth Center. Founded Feb 2016 — TTS/ASR, custom timbre, voice clone, emotion synth, voice conversion; data labeling across speech/vision/NLP + self-built tools; AI+SaaS open platform closing data→tech→industry-solution loop.

ChatGPT/LLM wave raises demand for high-quality data — Beibei offers “nanny-level” custom data design, fine-tune-from-scratch and lifelong-learning pipelines to cut compute/time. AIGC content window: DNN voice stack for generic + specialty custom (standard/premium clone) → low-barrier batch content gen. CEO Liu Bo: keep “data + tech + solutions” to unleash mass content and expand scenes — “let AI empower the digital world.” State Council AI plan cite: core AI industry >¥400B by 2025; related >¥5T.

— END —
